claude.performance_metric: positive net income each year ($238.5M/$312.6M/$233.8M, FY2017-2019); one operation divested (Lone Mountain, 2017)
claude.rationale: The realized record documents positive net income in all three post-emergence years, revenues stable near $2.3-2.5B, resumed capital returns, and no second insolvency proceeding — no documented product/operations incoherence, so p4=0. Management continuity is documented (same CEO John Eaves since 2012 and same President/COO Paul Lang since 2015, no leadership change through FY2019) with no documented operations-vs-organization fracture, so p5=0. The slice is a Chapter 11 emergence outcome, not an announced merger archetype or a two-business-model combination, and provides no evidence bearing on t1 or t2, so both are coded uncertain.

gemini.performance_metric: positive net income each year ($238.5M to $312.6M) and resumed capital returns
gemini.rationale: The slice documents positive net income, steady revenues, and capital returns (dividends and share repurchases) over the 3-year post-emergence window. There is no evidence of product/process disruption (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway); management remained continuous and the company operated profitably.

openai.performance_metric: positive net income in each of 2017-2019 ($238.5M, $312.6M, $233.8M)
openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented; the company maintained annual revenues near $2.3-$2.5 billion and reported positive net income in each year from 2017 through 2019. No process/organization fracture is documented; the same CEO and President/COO remained in their roles throughout the window, with no documented second insolvency proceeding.
